headline: DEATH ROW 💉 WOMAN'S 😵 PROGNOSIS STILL UNCLEAR 🏥 After FAILED ⚰️ EXECUTION 🪓
text:
CHRISTA 🧍‍♀️ PIKE'S prognosis 🩺 remains UNCLEAR 😶 after her botched 💥 execution attempt 🪓 that left her critically ill 🛏️ in hospital 🏥 her lawyer 🧑‍⚖️ revealed on Sunday 🌅 while doctors 👨‍⚕️ scramble to flush two full lethal doses 💉 of pentobarbital 🧪 from her system 🩸 Pike the 50-year-old convicted murderer 🔪 who was sentenced to death ⚰️ for killing Colleen Slemmer ☠️ back in 1995 📅 survived not one but TWO separate execution tries 🥵 on Wednesday 🗓️ before getting rushed 🚑 to a Nashville Tennessee hospital 🏥 where she remains hooked to a ventilator 😤 breathing machine.

Her attorney Stephen Ferrell told CNN 📺 that she's still critically ill 🩹 on life support 🫁 with doctors 👨‍⚕️ desperately trying to clear the pentobarbital 🧪 poison from her blood 🩸 and they honestly don't know the prognosis yet 🧐 it could be several days 📆 before any real update emerges Ferrell added that Pike hasn't regained consciousness 😵 at any point during this ordeal 🔥 and he's only getting medical updates 📋 through her power of attorney 🧾 instead of talking directly to the docs 👨‍⚕️ himself because authorities are keeping her super guarded 🚫 with limited visitors 👀.

Ferrell hasn't even been allowed to see her in person 👤 and he has no clue who if anyone has actually laid eyes on Pike 👁️ during this nightmare 😱 meanwhile Tennessee Governor Bill Lee 🗳️ stepped up and suspended ALL executions ⚰️ for the rest of the year 📅 after this disaster 💥 and the head of the state's prisons 🏛️ announced he would resign 🏃‍♂️ effective Saturday 🗓️ with no explanation yet from authorities on exactly what went wrong during the lethal injection process 💉 that clearly COOKED this whole protocol 🍳.

If Pike somehow recovers 🩹 she might not fully bounce back 🧠 and there could be massive questions about her mental competence 🧩 after enduring what her lawyer calls a torturous attempt at execution 🔥 Ferrell stressed that she's already spent over 30 years 🕰️ in prison mostly in solitary confinement 🔒 and this botched execution has left everyone wondering what sort of hidden damage 🩸 she suffered during those failed attempts 🪓 he called on the governor to commute her sentence to life in prison at the very least ⚖️ saying the state owes her some mercy after this horror show 🎪.

Pike was only 18 🧒 when she and her then boyfriend Tadaryl Shipp 👫 beat tortured and murdered 19-year-old Colleen Slemmer ☠️ in a case that sparked a massive media frenzy 📣 in Knoxville Tennessee back in 1995 📅 she was sentenced to death the next year after a trial that had the whole state gripped 📰 Slemmer's mother May Martinez flew to Nashville for the execution 🛫 and broke down in tears 😢 upon learning it failed completely she told local news that the state owes her a huge apology 🙏 because she supported the death sentence from the beginning ⚰️ yet now faces this endless uncertainty loop 🔄.

The state's Department of Correction defended their lethal injection protocol 🛡️ claiming it doesn't allow for any extra procedures beyond what they already carried out 🧪 but Pike's lawyers had previously warned about her medical history including thrombocytosis a blood clotting condition 🩸 plus her unusually small veins 🦵 that put her at risk of unnecessary pain and suffering during any lethal injection attempt 💉 Tennessee prison chief is resigning after this fiasco 🏃‍♂️ and experts who've witnessed nearly 500 executions say they've never seen anything quite like Christa Pike's nightmare case 😱 with her prognosis still hanging in limbo after the pentobarbital doses refused to finish the job properly 🧪.
